ownerScopeRefinement.interpretation: The IndexedDB observation proves byte-storage mechanics for both sampled artifact types. Production admission additionally requires release-authorized interval digests, which currently exist only for COG chunks.

decision.wholeResponsePersistence: Cache Storage may be used only for explicitly routed complete responses with exact byte, MIME, integrity, policy, and app/release authority.
decision.rangePersistence: Persist only complete release-authorized COG chunks in bounded IndexedDB. PMTiles remains network-only with no-store fetch and response caching policies and must not enter Cache Storage, IndexedDB, or the session-memory range store until a separately reviewed promotion contract supplies authoritative interval digests.
decision.rangeResponse: Return only an exact authorized COG chunk or a half-open slice contained by that single chunk; never assemble adjacent records to manufacture interval authority.
decision.cacheMatchRule: Never rely on Cache.match(request-with-Range) to distinguish a partial request from a cached whole response.
decision.transactionRule: Byte admission, metadata, accounting, and eviction must share one IndexedDB transaction boundary where practical.
decision.releaseRule: Every record must be isolated by exact application build, dataReleaseId, and artifact identity; no range may cross an authority.
decision.scientificFailureRule: Cache, network, integrity, quota, transaction, storage, and update failures are technical states, not additional ADR-024 scientific outcomes.
decision.privateCandidateRule: Candidate-v7 remains explicit, local, read-only, and session-only; it is never a durable browser, build, CI, or external-storage input.

limitations: This is a same-origin loopback measurement, not evidence for a deployed public origin, CDN, CORS policy, or R2 behavior.
The host measurement is macOS arm64; Linux CI and other operating systems remain unmeasured here.

The test covers one deterministic 64-byte range and contained 16-byte slice for each committed fixture artifact; it does not measure quota, eviction, overlapping intervals, concurrency, browser restart durability, or storage pressure.
The probe exercises browser Cache Storage and IndexedDB directly; it does not implement or validate the production service worker or range store.
Candidate-v7, TAR files, private artifacts, external storage, and public network services were not accessed.
